label: Slack App Messages (all workspaces)
description: Fires on messages in EVERY workspace that installed your own Slack app, for app owners distributing it; for a bot in your own workspace use Slack Receive Message. Needs a connection through your own app with its Socket Mode token (xapp-...) pasted; weft dials out, so no public address is needed.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Your own app's connection, with the xapp-... token pasted; needs channels:history on the installs.

inputs.name: keyword
inputs.label: Contains
inputs.placeholder: Only fire when the text contains this
inputs.description: Only fire when the text contains this. Empty = every message.

inputs.name: includeBots
inputs.label: Include bot messages
inputs.description: Also fire on bot messages, this app's own included. Off so a workflow that posts cannot trigger itself.
